Iris: Drafting a short internal release note for tomorrow's 02:00 UTC window. Need ops runbook + Comms to prepare internal/public variants. Paste below.

Iris: ```
Release v2.3.1 (patch)
- Fix: dispatcher memory leak under burst, reduces OOMs on high-concurrency
- Optimization: KV cache heuristics adjusted (expected ~12% token cost win on chat workloads)
- Ops: internal canary pin then public flip; auto-fallback to v2.2.9 on latency spike
- Impact: no API changes; SDK patch-level bump only
```

Sam: Nice and concise. Ops asks: add exact CLI for pin + rollback, and a one-line rollback trigger we can wire into automations. Also include canary sample size (we use 5% traffic by default).

Iris: Added lines: 
- Internal pin CLI: `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --scope internal --actor @Sam`
- Public flip CLI: `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --scope public --actor @Chang`
- Rollback CLI: `./deploy rollback --to v2.2.9 --reason "p99>200ms_10m"`
- Automatic trigger: sustained p99 >200ms for 10m or error rate >3x baseline -> auto-fallback to v2.2.9
- Canary traffic: 5% by default, can increase to 10% if early metrics look good

Chang: Ops runbook (short):
1) T-30m: post internal announce with runbook + CLI snippets (Iris)
2) T0 (02:00 UTC): run internal pin (Sam) and start automated checks (p50/p95/p99, errors, host OOMs)
3) Canary window: 5% traffic for 10m, if stable optionally scale to 10% for another 20m
4) If stable after 90m total, run public flip (Chang posts public blurb)
5) If rollback criteria met at any time, run rollback CLI and open #incident-release-<change-id>

ops-oncall: Roster: @ops-oncall (primary), @Lena (backup). I'll monitor from 01:50-04:00 UTC. We'll auto-create the incident channel when auto-fallback triggers. Confirmed watch.

Iris: Comms: please prep two thumbnails: internal (detailed) and public (customer-friendly). Public should avoid implementation details. Also note: internal will include the rollback snippet and the runbook steps.

Comms: Got it. Public blurb draft: "Patch release to improve stability and reduce service errors; no customer action required." Internal will contain CLI and ops checklist. I'll attach both to the PR.

Sam: Quick Q: do we want a manual TTL on the internal pin (auto-unpin after X hours) or keep it pinned until flip? I'd prefer explicit flip to public to avoid accidental rollbacks.

Chang: Agree. No TTL. Manual flip only: internal pin stays until Chang runs public flip. Reduces surprises.

Iris: OK we'll keep manual flip. Add a note in internal announce: "Do not unpin unless rollback required or flip to public is executed."

deploy-bot: Deploybot scheduled: window=2026-03-24T02:00:00Z, duration=30m, change-id=ch_172345, canary=true, canary-traffic=5%, auto-fallback=v2.2.9.

Sam: I'll run the internal pin at T0 and monitor the dashboards. If I see p99 creeping, I'll post the rollback CLI and reason here before executing.

Comms: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/601 has both internal + public variants. Please review by COB. I'll queue the public blast for T+90m but won't send until Chang signals go.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Roster and monitors set. I'll also add a dashboard bookmark for quick triage links in the internal announce.

Chang: LGTM. I'll be ready to run the public flip if metrics look solid.

Iris: Thanks all 44d Locking this thread for prep. Will reopen if any late edits.
